title: CodeJudgeBench: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Coding Tasks
authors_zh: Hongchao Jiang, Yiming Chen, Yushi Cao, Hung-yi Lee, Robby T. Tan
paper_type_zh: 代码 LLM-as-a-Judge 基准与可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要比较、校准或审计代码生成、修复和单元测试判别器的研究者。
one_line: Coding judge benchmark covering generation, repair, and unit-test judgments and their order sensitivity.
用 5,352 个经验证候选对系统测试代码 LLM 判别器，并暴露顺序和来源敏感性。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: 以 5,352 个经验证代码候选对覆盖生成、修复和单测判别，直接量化 LLM 判别器的能力、顺序敏感性与提示依赖。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code LLM judges are increasingly used to rank generated programs, yet existing benchmarks emphasize simple generation tasks or general-domain responses. A model that writes code well may still be unreliable at distinguishing subtle functional errors, and a stable score is needed before using a judge for selection or evaluation.

CodeJudgeBench supplies a dedicated execution-free judging benchmark for code generation, code repair, and unit-test generation. It evaluates whether a judge consistently chooses the better of two verified candidates and then probes robustness to order, source model, and prompting choices. Because its tasks and candidates concern code functionality, it tests whether a judge recognizes executable semantic differences rather than merely preferring fluent, long, or reference-like text.

代码 LLM 判别器正被用于排序生成程序，但既有基准多偏向简单生成题或通用文本。会写代码不代表能稳定识别细微的功能错误；在把判别器用于选择或评测前，需要任务相关且可验证的可靠性分数。

CodeJudgeBench 为代码生成、修复和单元测试构造专门的免执行判别基准。它要求模型在两份已验证候选中选出更好者，并继续检验候选顺序、来源模型和提示方式是否改变结论。题目与候选来自代码功能任务，因而它检验的是判别器能否识别可执行语义差异，而非仅偏好更流畅、更长或更像参考答案的文本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CodeJudgeBench is a 5,352-pair benchmark whose record contains an instruction, a verified good response, and a verified bad response across three coding tasks. It sources recent competition problems, collects candidate outputs from frontier generators, verifies them against ground truth or execution, and pairs opposite outcomes. The release includes dataset configurations and code under Apache 2.0; it is an evaluation surface, not a newly trained judge. Each pair label comes from external correctness verification, allowing a judge choice to be compared with traceable functional outcomes rather than another model preference.

CodeJudgeBench 含 5,352 个候选对，每条由指令、经验证的正确回答和错误回答组成，覆盖三类编程任务。它从近期竞赛题收集前沿模型输出，用标准答案或执行核验，再配对相反结果。官方发布数据集配置和代码，数据采用 Apache 2.0；其贡献是评测表面，不是新训练的判别器。记录还保留任务类型与候选内容，便于复查。每个候选对的标签由外部正确性核验而来，因而判别器的选择可与可追溯的功能结果对照，而非只与另一模型的偏好对照。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Draw 1,055 recent competition problems from LiveCodeBench-v6, covering May 2023 to April 2025, as tasks less exposed to older models.
  2. Ask strong generators to produce code, repairs, or unit-test outputs. For generation and repair, execute candidates against test cases; for unit tests, compare the generated expected output with ground truth.
  3. Keep verified correct and incorrect outputs and discard problems that provide only one outcome. Pair one good and one bad candidate with the same instruction; randomize their presentation for pairwise judging.
  4. Evaluate 26 judges with pairwise, pointwise, or best-of-N formats, reporting accuracy against the verified preference and analyses by task, difficulty, source model, and order swap.
  5. Reproduce with the released dataset and prompts; fix dataset revision, generator outputs, execution harness, response preprocessing, and position order because each can alter the result.

1. 从 LiveCodeBench-v6 取 1,055 道 2023 年 5 月至 2025 年 4 月的竞赛题，以降低旧模型已见题风险。
  2. 让强生成器产出代码、修复或单测结果；生成和修复用测试用例执行，单测把预期输出与标准答案比对。
  3. 保留已验证的正确和错误输出，删除只出现单一结果的题目；对同一指令配对一好一坏候选，并随机化成对呈现顺序。
  4. 用成对、逐点和 Best-of-N 方式评测 26 个判别器，以正确偏好为准确率，并分析任务、难度、来源模型和交换顺序。
  5. 复现时固定数据版本、执行环境、输出预处理和候选位置，因为这些设置都会改变分数。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim — even strong LLM judges remain unreliable on difficult functional coding comparisons, and pairwise prompting is more effective than scalar pointwise scoring in this benchmark.

Setup — 26 open and closed judges were tested on the 5,352 verified pairs from code generation, repair, and test generation. The authors additionally swapped candidate order and compared full responses, code-plus-comments, and code-only inputs.

Result — Gemini-2.5-Pro achieved 81% accuracy on CodeJudgeBench code generation, while it scored 98% on JudgeBench's code split; the paper reports that pairwise prompting outperformed pointwise prompting. It also finds substantially different predictions after order swaps.

Boundary — accuracy depends on the benchmark's verified candidates and its execution-free judge setup; it does not establish reliability for security, style, repository-scale tasks, or every future generator distribution.

主张——即使强 LLM 判别器在高难功能性代码比较中仍不稳定，且本基准上的成对提示优于标量逐点评分。

设置——论文在 5,352 个来自生成、修复和单测的已验证候选对上测试 26 个开源与闭源判别器，并交换候选顺序，比较完整回答、代码加注释和仅代码输入。

结果——Gemini-2.5-Pro 在本基准代码生成任务上准确率为 81%，而在 JudgeBench 的代码划分为 98%；论文报告成对提示优于逐点提示，且交换顺序会显著改变预测。

边界——准确率依赖于该基准的候选核验和免执行设置，不能推出其对安全、风格、仓库级任务或未来生成器分布同样可靠。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier judge sets usually cover general responses or only code generation and often contain easier outputs from older generators. CodeJudgeBench changes both task coverage and error difficulty: it spans generation, repair, and unit tests, then builds good/bad pairs from recent frontier-model outputs that are checked against ground truth. The contribution is not a new functional metric; it is a harder verified pairwise evaluation surface and a reliability analysis of how judges react to presentation choices. This distinguishes high scores on old easy items from reliable choice between subtly flawed candidates, the latter being closer to the risk in practical response ranking.

既有判别基准常覆盖通用回答或只涵盖代码生成，且候选错误较易识别。CodeJudgeBench 同时改变任务覆盖和错误难度：它涵盖生成、修复、单元测试，并用近期前沿模型输出构造经真值验证的正负候选对。新意不是提出新的功能指标，而是提供更难的成对评测表面，并系统审计呈现方式为何会影响代码判别结论。由此它能区分“在旧而容易的题上高分”与“在细微错误候选之间仍能可靠选择”这两种能力，后者更接近实际排序风险。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The benchmark measures execution-free judgments of functional correctness, so it does not assess maintainability, security, explanation quality, or project-level constraints. Its labels rely on the selected tests and ground-truth outputs; an inadequate test suite can miss semantically wrong programs. Frontier-generated pairs may age as generators and benchmarks change, and order sensitivity itself means a single prompt run is not a sufficient audit. Reusers should execute additional hidden tests and report both presentation orders. Moreover, candidates come from specific generators; errors and difficulty may differ substantially for human code or tool-use traces.
该基准衡量的是免执行的功能正确性判断，不评测可维护性、安全性、解释质量或仓库级约束。标签依赖选定测试和标准输出；若测试不足，语义错误程序可能未被发现。前沿模型产生的候选会随模型和基准演进而过时，顺序敏感性也说明单次提示不足以完成审计。复用时应增加隐藏测试，并同时报告两种候选顺序下的结果。此外，候选由特定生成器产生，判别器若面对人类代码或工具调用轨迹，错误类型和难度分布可能明显不同。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A team selecting a code judge can load the three released task splits, run each candidate judge on both response orders, and compare accuracy against the verified good/bad label. The output is a task-specific score plus an order-robustness report; success requires accuracy above a chosen baseline and small swap-induced disagreement. Researchers can also use the pairs to compare pairwise and scalar prompts before deploying response ranking. Do not treat it as a replacement for executing code when a safe execution environment or security review is available. Deployment logs should retain candidate order, raw responses, and preprocessing version so inconsistent cases can be replayed instead of retaining only an aggregate accuracy.
选择代码判别器的团队可加载三个官方任务划分，让每个候选模型在两种回答顺序下判别，并与已验证标签比较。输出是任务分数和顺序稳健性报告；成功标准是超过预设基线且交换顺序后的分歧较小。研究者也可在部署回答排序前比较成对与标量提示。若可安全执行代码或需安全审查，不应以此替代真实执行和人工检查。部署记录应保留候选顺序、原始回答和预处理版本，使低一致性案例可回放，而不是只保存一个汇总准确率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: CodeJudgeBench audits code judges, not code generators, through verified good-versus-bad response pairs.
  2. Method handle: collect frontier outputs, verify correctness, remove one-sided tasks, then randomize a good/bad pair.
  3. Artifact handle: the official 6,363-row dataset release exposes codegen, repair, and testgen fields under Apache 2.0; the paper's benchmark subset has 5,352 pairs.
  4. Evidence anchor: Gemini-2.5-Pro falls from 98% on JudgeBench code to 81% on this CodeGen task.
  5. Reuse decision: test both orders and prompt forms before ranking responses; first validate labels with an independent execution harness.

1. 定位：CodeJudgeBench 审计代码判别器，而非代码生成器，核心是已验证的正负候选对。
  2. 方法：收集前沿输出、核验正确性、删除单边题目，再随机配对一好一坏回答。
  3. 产物：官方 6,363 行数据含 codegen、repair、testgen 字段并采用 Apache 2.0；论文基准含 5,352 对。
  4. 证据：Gemini-2.5-Pro 在 JudgeBench 代码划分 98%，在此代码生成任务降至 81%。
  5. 决策：用于排序前先测两种顺序和提示形式，并用独立执行环境复核标签。
